messages.content: Alice can complete a project in 12 days. Bob can complete the same project in 8 days. If they work together, how many days will it take to complete the project? Round to two decimal places.

response.content: Combined work rate = 1/12 + 1/8. Common denominator 24: 2/24 + 3/24 = 5/24 of the project per day together. Time required = 1 / (5/24) = 24/5 = 4.8 days exactly, which rounds to 4.80 days. The answer is 4.80 days.
